oneLiner: Split shared trip expenses with friends in seconds—no spreadsheet required.
problem: Groups on trips struggle to track who paid for what and who owes whom; spreadsheets are error-prone, tedious, and awkward to share on the go.
targetUser: Friend groups, couples, and colleagues aged 18–40 planning weekend getaways, road trips, or group vacations who want a fair, fast way to settle shared costs.
coreFlow: Create a trip and invite friends via link or email
Add expenses as they happen (who paid, amount, who it's for)
View a live summary of balances and who owes whom
Settle up with one tap and mark payments as done

screens.name: Trip Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of the trip, recent expenses, and current balance summary

screens.name: Add Expense
screens.purpose: Quickly log a new shared cost with payer, amount, and participants

screens.name: Balances
screens.purpose: Show net amounts owed between each pair of travelers

screens.name: Settle Up
screens.purpose: Record repayments and finalize the trip

outOfScope: Integration with bank accounts or payment processors
